author: potuz
content: <@97774605351010304> <@731289513942450317> do you think Ethcoordinate or ethstaker whatever is called now could work on keeping a semi-official list of builder endpoints? It would be something like curating a list of builders with their endpoints, which text their require for signed auths, which types of bids they will return (trusted/trustless) and nothing more. This will allow CL clients to point to a a single URL to download a json and use that as a config to update builders.

author: potuz
content: Mev Boost maintainers were working on such a standard but it seems that they moved to keeping Mev Boost to do this in part, so I want to have a community effort to find and advertise builders

author: butta
content:
there is currently https://ethstaker.org/mev-relay-list (see ePBS relay list for Hoodi testnet) section. 

Does that fulfil the criteria?

author: potuz
content: Yes, I want something like this, but something consumable by the CL client directly so as to automate builder discovery. The  point is that we can now trustlessly download such a list now and simply call those builders without needing to trust you. We need to just define a format for the file and have ethstaker post it somewhere

author: potuz
content: the most important point is that ethstaker should also keep it updated, if any builder appears in the wild with an endpoint serving trustless bids for example, ethstaker should just add it to the list
